task: Coalesce Reset/Fault batches and observe saved communication diagnostics

pc01_source_native.scope: 32-bit Windows Python, actual NI CVI runtime; in-memory simulator and direct local UI action adapter
pc01_source_native.visual_review: Native status/counters/buttons inspected; larger event text and compact wrapped rows

limitations: No physical equipment writes or long-duration equipment run were used to validate this patch.
The existing FIFO priority and OFF/STOP queue policy are preserved; no maximum STATUS latency guarantee.
Malformed instrument response parsing, TCP framing compatibility and RES12 parameters are outside this patch.
Event retention is bounded per session; session directories and other diagnostics are not automatically removed.
